rationale: The agent located the user and relevant orders via tools and executed an exchange on the delivered laptop, providing final specs and a refund amount. However, policy requires explicit customer confirmation before any order-changing write. The agent proceeded to call exchange_delivered_order_items without first confirming details (e.g., model, color, price difference/refund destination) with the user. Using a specific payment method ID for the transaction also lacked prior confirmation. While authentication via name and ZIP and acting on the user’s order appear acceptable, the absence of pre-write confirmation is a clear policy violation, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
